rotor.parameter_validity: Research aggregate transfer: H/tau from Shah et al. arXiv:2204.13894 Table I; PF base, delay, deadband, speed domain, shaft loss and feedback scale are registered research assumptions, not hospital OEM settings.
rotor.work_budget_basis: shaft mechanical electric-equivalent kWh; not liters/kg
rotor.electrical_scope: externally verified connected load, no new permissions
rotor.shutdown_assumption: Minute-scale research shutdown: immediate breaker opening and fuel torque cut at the resolved shaft-work budget boundary; Pm is power, not stored energy. Retain rotor energy and dissipate it only through declared shaft loss. No refueling or restart is modeled; not an OEM shutdown transient.

config.provenance: All limits here are illustrative research assumptions, NOT OEM relay or hospital safety ratings.
config.priority: strict lexicographic 0,1,2,3 then cost; each carrier normalized by total demand; P0-P2 lock abs tolerance 1e-7, P3 lock abs tolerance 1e-5, with relative tolerance
config.cascade: Delayed pre-control proxy subtracts incremental grid headroom, diesel reserve available after start delay, and executable P3/P2/P1 shedding (P0 preserved) before sharing residual across surviving GTs; not a network or relay simulation.
config.dynamic_temperature: baseline DOE zone mean temperature + uncalibrated 1R1C cold-loss perturbation
config.cost: uses historical 2001 prices from v2; diesel $0.30/kWh illustrative only

execution_contract.name: p1b_no_export_interlock_v14_finite_gt_v15_local_diesel_v16_essential
execution_contract.provenance: V16 shared boundary floor regulation and fuel depletion continuation; shaft-work equivalent budget

diagnostic.critical_envelope_semantics: Registered static current-demand envelope; main loads and low history unchanged
diagnostic.grid_tracking_basis: generated command ceiling; operating tariff uses current imported energy
diagnostic.preparation_semantics: Static current stress copies and registered duration preference, not predictions or real disposal
diagnostic.standby_semantics: Soft third commanded-on GT exposure after original P0/P1 locks; not arrived reserve or future protection
diagnostic.regulator_semantics: Existing stable-floor pressure assumption; not arrived output or a temporal prediction

layers.name: arrived_current_P0

layers.name: arrived_current_P1
layers.unit: normalized conditional current carrier ENS at the named execution stage

layers.name: preparation_P0

layers.name: preparation_P1
layers.unit: sum of normalized static carrier ENS; not probability

layers.name: preparation_defect
layers.unit: kW: fuel preference excess plus static unabsorbable surplus

layers.name: actual_command_shaft_support
layers.unit: shaft equivalent kWh excess over registered duration budget

layers.name: arrived_current_P2
layers.unit: normalized conditional current carrier ENS at the named execution stage

layers.name: arrived_current_P3
layers.unit: normalized conditional current carrier ENS at the named execution stage

layers.name: standby_third_GT_exposure
layers.unit: GT count above two commanded on; not minimum total GT count

layers.name: normal_online_GT_count_after_preparation
layers.unit: commanded online GT count; soft preference only

layers.name: healthy_converter_permission
layers.unit: minimum unused healthy ordinary converter permission after service and cost locks

service_budget.units: kWh per current original decision step

coordination.critical_cold_contact_semantics: P0/P1 cold requests remain connected by ordinary command; actual unmet remains physical ENS
coordination.known_unresolved_joint_path: continuous GT local-down plus connected permitted DG remains M16 unknown

engineering.observed_critical_fraction_basis: previous measured loss over lawful current demand; control signal only, not reclassification
